title: Workflow Gateboard: see what will run
audience: Developers and inheritors who need repository-declared checks to stay visible, bounded, and continuation-ready.
promise: Load the repository contract, preview prerequisites and mutation class, run one declared non-mutating gate, and leave a target-bound receipt.
story: A repository-owned manifest declares three read-only gates and their dependency chain.
The board blocks a dependent test before its syntax prerequisite has passed.
After the prerequisite is explicitly satisfied, syntax, tests, and package run as read-only gates.
Each result writes a bounded receipt tied to the same Git target revision.
verified_locally: Repository-declared gate list with dependency and mutation state.
Current dev syntax receipt and dependent-test/package blocking on separate CLI invocations.
Historical W2 fixture records the full pass chain; the current tracked ref remains unchanged while the syntax receipt is written.
open_gates: Connect one declared gate to Automation Flight Recorder parent/child trace evidence.
Persist or explicitly reload passed prerequisite state across CLI invocations before claiming a continued gate sequence.
Expand stale, blocked, failed, and not-run state receipts on the current surface.
Capture a crop-safe image preview and verify a hosted no-auth case.
Record external GitHub, portfolio, and Handshake readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet combines the historical W2 declared-gate fixture with a current dev checkpoint. It does not claim a persisted CLI pass sequence, hosted CI parity, trace integration, concurrent refresh recovery, or publication.
